runs.text: According to the Bible, all humans are born slaves to the fear of death. (See Hebrews 2:15.) One main reason for this is that many do not know their destiny, or what happens to them when they die.

The devil’s first deception for mankind was in the Garden of Eden. God had told our first parents that if they ate the forbidden fruit, they would surely die. Satan lied to Eve, saying: “Ye shall not surely die.” (Genesis 3:4) This deception has continued to grow ever since. In this study, we will look at how this deception has caused men to distrust God’s love.

Pagan religions got the idea of an immortal soul from the Egyptians. Unfortunately, this idea was brought into the Christian church. This deception became complete when the early church fathers made it a part of Christian teaching. The Bible does not teach that people go directly to heaven or hell upon their death. The Bible teaches us that upon death we sleep in the grave in the hope of the resurrection.

One of the most damaging of all the erroneous beliefs in the Christian church is a belief in eternal torment. Eternal torment is the belief that God torments forever those who do not believe in Him. Unfortunately, there are many serious-minded people who have rejected God because of this doctrine. Many honest pastors who believe this doctrine refuse to preach it. Others preach it with relish.

Satan has used this error to keep many people from fully understanding God’s love. The believer in Christ should not be afraid of God. We should be able to pray to God as to a friend. Throughout the Scriptures, we find that God is love. So let us take a closer look at this subject that has affected each one of us to some degree. Let’s be honest with the texts and ask God to show us the truth.
IMMORTALITY:
1. What did Adam become when God breathed into his nostrils the breath of life?
Genesis 2:7
And the LORD God formed man of the dust of the ground, and
breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
Note:

God did not put a soul into man as is popularly believed. God breathed life into man, and he became a living soul. (See Genesis 2:7) This is why the same word “soul” is used in the original language of Scripture to define the life of even animals. Strong’s Concordance uses the word soul to describe “life force” 117 times, “a person” 20 times, and “creatures” 9 times. So we must be aware of how Scripture intends the use of the word before we conclude what it means.
2. Where did the idea of a naturally immortal life or soul first come from?
Genesis 3:1

Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which the LORD God had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden? 2 And the woman said unto the serpent, We may eat of the fruit of the trees of the garden: 3 But of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, God hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die. 4
And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die.
Note:
The idea that sinners have natural immortality, whether in heaven or hell, came from Satan. This was the first lie that has been perpetuated ever since the fall of Adam and Eve.
We see this error taught in Egyptian, Greek, and Pagan religions. (Search:
Plato and Socrates
Immortal Soul.
3. Who only has natural immortality?
1 Timothy 6:16
Lord of lords, who only hath immortality.
Note:
Only God has natural immortality. He bestows immortality as a gift only to those who accept Jesus
4. What two things did Christ accomplish on the cross?
2 Timothy 1:10
But is now made manifest by the appearing of
our Savior Jesus Christ, who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel.
Note:

When Adam and Eve sinned in the Garden of Eden, they forfeited their immortality. We, their offspring, are also condemned to die because of our own sin. Christ will restore immortality only to those who accept His death for the forgiveness of their sins. Those who reject Christ are condemned to die in the lake of fire at the end of time. (See Revelation 20:15)
5. How do we receive the gift of eternal life?
1 John 5:11
And this is the record, that God hath given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
He that hath the Son hath life; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life.
Note:
When we by faith receive Jesus Christ as our personal Savior, the gift of eternal life becomes ours. But if we reject Christ, we will not have eternal life.
ETERNAL FIRE?
6. What is the type of fire that is prepared for Satan?
Matthew 25:41
Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels.
Note:
The words “everlasting fire” mean that the result of the fire is everlasting. It does not mean that the cursed will be tortured forever in a forever-burning fire.
7. How long does the smoke of torment rise?
Revelation 14:11
And
the smoke of their torment ascendeth up for ever and ever
Note
: Let’s discover the Biblical meaning of for ever!
8. How long was the servant to serve his master?
Exodus 21:6
Then his master shall bring him unto the judges; he shall also bring him to the door, or unto the door post; and
his master shall bore his ear through with an aul; and he shall serve him for ever
Note:

How does the Bible use the word for ever? The servant was to serve his master “for ever”, which could only mean his lifetime. The Bible says that at the end of time the wicked will be destroyed and the smoke of their torment will ascend up for ever and ever. (See Revelation 14:11) In the language of the Bible, “for ever” does not mean that God will torture human beings for all eternity.
9. How long did forever last in 1 Samuel 1:22, 28?
1 Samuel 1:22
But Hannah went not up; for she said unto her husband, I will not go up until the child be weaned, and then I will bring him, that he may appear before the LORD,
and there abide for ever
Therefore also I have lent him to the LORD; as long as he liveth he shall be lent to the LORD
. And he worshiped the LORD
Note: “

For ever” is definitely defined in this text. For ever meant as long as he lived. The reason that we are spending so much time on this word is that eternal torment has put God on trial in many people’s minds.
10. Another example is in:
Jonah 2:6
I went down to the bottoms of the mountains;
the earth with her bars was about me for ever
: yet hast thou brought up my life from corruption, O LORD my God.
Note:

In this text, Jonah was swallowed by the fish for three days. But scripture says he was there for ever. The Bible uses the words “for ever” as we do the words big and little. They are relative words. The usage of the words “for ever” relates to definite time periods. Its use depends upon what it is referring to. There is a big difference between a big diamond, a big elephant, and a big building. But they are all big.
DOES ETERNAL FIRE GO OUT?
11. How completely will the wicked be destroyed?
Malachi 4:1
the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven; and all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble: and the day that cometh shall burn them up
saith the LORD of hosts, that it shall leave them neither root nor branch
. 3 And ye shall tread down the wicked; for
they shall be ashes under the soles of your feet in the day that I shall do this, saith the LORD of hosts
Note:

To sum up all these verses, it simply means that as long as the wicked are still alive, they will suffer. Some may suffer longer than others. But the wicked will finally be completely destroyed leaving only ashes.

Many people do not think this is enough punishment. But if a boy fifteen years old was to get drunk one Saturday night and was killed in an accident. Do you think the God of love and mercy would cast that child into a fiery furnace and never ever, stop burning him? The Bible is based on love and common sense. This would violate both of these principles. Even man, as wicked as he is, would not torture someone for all eternity.
12. What example has God recorded in Scripture of the everlasting or eternal fire that will finally destroy the wicked?
Jude 7
Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities about them in like manner, giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh, are set forth
for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire
Note:
God has given us an
example

of exactly what eternal fire is to be like in the destruction of Sodom and Gomorrha. They were destroyed by eternal fire. Today there is nothing left. They are not still burning today. But their destruction is eternal.
13. What were Sodom and Gomorrha turned into as an example of the punishment of the wicked?
2 Peter 2:6
And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes
condemned them with an overthrow,
making them an
ensample
unto those that after should live ungodly.
Note:
Those cast into the eternal fire at the end of time will also be turned into ashes. They will not be tortured forever and ever. They will be burned up.
14. What happens to the soul that sins?
Ezekiel 18:4
Behold, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is mine:
the soul that sinneth, it shall die.
Ezekiel 18:20
The soul that sinneth, it shall die

. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son: the righteousness of the righteous shall be upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon him.
Note:

Here are clear statements in Scripture that when a soul sins it shall die. By the word soul, the Bible means the whole of the person who sins will die. Death is the wages of sin, not eternal punishment. (See Romans 6:23)
15. What happens to a person’s knowledge and feelings when he or she dies?
Ecclesiastes 9:5
For the living know that they shall die:
but the dead know not any thing
, neither have they any more a reward; for the memory of them is forgotten. 6
Also their love, and their hatred, and their envy, is now perished; neither have they any more a portion for ever in any thing that is done under the sun.
Note:
In death, all our thoughts and feelings come to an end. The Bible is clear that we cannot communicate with the dead. This too is a deception of the devil.
16. When one departs from the truth of the gospel and you bring that person back to the Lord, what have you saved that soul from?
James 5:20
Let him know, that
he which converteth the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death
, and shall hide a multitude of sins.
Note:
Once again, the word
soul
(KJV) means the total person. When Adam sinned, the total person forfeited life, and the only way to have eternal life is through faith in Christ.
SOUL SLEEP:
17. How did Christ describe the death of Lazarus to His disciples?
John 11:11
Our friend Lazarus sleepeth;
but I go, that I may awake him out of sleep. 12 Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well. 13
Howbeit Jesus spake of his death: but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep
Then said Jesus unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.
Note:
Lazarus was a believer who had died of an illness. Jesus described his death as a sleep because believers do not experience eternal death. Believers sleep in the grave awaiting the resurrection.
18. What hope did Jesus give Martha, the sister of Lazarus, regarding the resurrection?
John 11:20

Then Martha, as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming, went and met him: but Mary sat still in the house. 21 Then said Martha unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died. 22 But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give it thee. 23
Jesus saith unto her, Thy brother shall rise again.
24 Martha saith unto him, I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day. 25
Jesus said unto her, I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live.
Note:
The hope of a Christian is not experienced at death but at the resurrection. This will take place at the second coming of Christ.
ETERNAL LIFE AT CHRIST’S SECOND COMING:
19. What will happen when Jesus returns?
1 Thessalonians 4:13
But I would not have you to be ignorant, brethren, concerning them which are asleep

, that ye sorrow not, even as others which have no hope. 14 For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him. 15 For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord, that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep. 16
For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of God: and the dead in Christ shall rise first:
Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air: and so shall we ever be with the Lord.
Note:
Because Jesus has conquered the grave, the believers have the guarantee that He can and will raise them from the dead.
20. When will the believers experience immortality?
1 Corinthians 15:51
Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,
In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye,
at the last trump
for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.
For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.
Note:
It is only at the second coming of Christ that believers will experience immortality. This is the blessed hope of all believers.
21. Jesus promised His disciples that He would one day take them to heaven. When did He say this would happen?
John 14:1
Let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me. 2
In my Father’s house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
And if I go and prepare a place for you,
I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also
Note:

Jesus promised to take His followers to heaven when He comes again. This happens at the second coming, not at their death. The Bible is clear that believers are asleep in Christ until the resurrection.
22. Didn’t Jesus say the thief would go to heaven that day?
Luke 23:43
And Jesus said unto him,
Verily I say unto thee, today shalt thou be with me in paradise
Note:
The original manuscripts of the Bible did not contain punctuation marks. The commas and periods at the end of the sentences were added thousands of years later. (See
Christianity.com
punctuation
) What this means is that, if you place the comma after the word “today”, the passage reads:
Verily I say unto thee today, thou shalt be with me in paradise
. Jesus Himself did not go to paradise that day. In fact, He later told Mary that He had not yet ascended to His Father. (See John 20:17)
John 20:17
Jesus saith unto her,
Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Fathe
r.
23. What power cannot touch the believers who will experience the first resurrection?
Revelation 20:6
Blessed and holy is he that hath part in the first resurrection: on such the second death hath no power
, but they shall be priests of God and of Christ, and shall reign with him a thousand years.
Note:

The Bible speaks of two resurrections, just as it speaks of the two deaths. The first death is referred to as a sleep because it will be followed by a resurrection at the second coming. The first resurrection will consist of those believers who are asleep in Christ and will at that time experience everlasting life. The unbelievers will rise in a later resurrection. Then after the judgment, they will experience eternal damnation. (See John 5:28, 29)
THE DANGERS OF SPIRITUALISM
24. What powerful delusion is growing rapidly today?
Leviticus 19:31
Regard not them that have familiar spirits
, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I am the LORD your God.
Note:
“Familiar spirit” refers to a “
spirit or demon that serves or prompts an individual”.
Another definition is “
the spirit of a dead person invoked by a medium to advise or prophesy”
. (See Webster’s Dictionary)

Spiritualism is the masterpiece of deception. It is Satan’s most successful and fascinating delusion—one calculated to take hold of the sympathies of those who have laid their loved ones in the grave. Evil angels come in the form of those loved ones, relate incidents connected with their lives, and perform acts which they performed while living. In this way they lead many to believe that their dead friends are angels hovering over them and communicating with them.
25. What will many people face before Jesus returns?
Matthew 24:24
For
there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect
Note:

Many will be confronted by the spirits of devils personating beloved relatives or friends and declaring the most dangerous heresies. These visitants will appeal to our tenderest sympathies and will work miracles to sustain their pretensions. They may claim new and more exalted systems of religious faith, heal diseases, or teach doctrines that contradict the plain words of Scripture. A belief in spiritual manifestations opens the door to seducing spirits and doctrines of devils.
26. How is spiritualism so deceiving?
2 Thessalonians 2:9
Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders
Note:

As spiritualism more closely imitates the nominal Christianity of the day, it has greater power to deceive and ensnare. Satan appears as a benefactor of the race, healing the diseases of the people and professing to present a new and more exalted system of religious faith; but at the same time he works as a destroyer. Little by little he has prepared the way for his masterpiece of deception in the development of spiritualism.
27. Warnings about spirits in the last days!
1 Timothy 4:1
Now the Spirit speaketh expressly, that
in the latter times some shall depart from the faith, giving heed to seducing spirits, and doctrines of devils
Note:

The influence of evil angels will be felt in the churches. Through spiritualism, Satan works with power and signs and lying wonders. Except those who are kept by the power of God, through faith in His word, the whole world will be swept into the ranks of this delusion. The people are fast being lulled to a fatal security.
28. How can we be kept safe from these deceptions?
1 John 4:1
Beloved,
believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God
: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.
Note:

We must be prepared to withstand these spirits with the Bible truth alone. Those who cling to God’s Word will not be deceived. The plain statements of Scripture will furnish weapons powerful in every conflict. The saints must have a thorough understanding of present truth from the Scriptures, especially the hope of the resurrection at the second coming of Christ.
GOD IS LOVE:

What we have learned is that God does not eternally torment people in the lake of fire. While a lake of fire exists at the end of time, it eventually ceases. This reflects God's character of love, where His justice aligns with His love.

We have also learned that the Bible teaches that the dead are asleep in their graves awaiting resurrection. God is love, and He pleads with us today: “Turn ye, turn ye from your evil ways; for why will ye die?” (Ezekiel 33:11)

Trust in God’s Word alone. Reject every form of spiritualism, mediums, séances, and the occult. Seeing a red bird does not mean a loved one has returned to visit from the grave. Other deceptions include lights flickering, objects moving, dreams/visions of the deceased, or claims of miraculous healings tied to spiritualist ideas. In the last days, such phenomena are expected to increase dramatically. Cling to the Bible truth about death and the resurrection, and you will be kept safe from the great deceptions of the last days. Jesus has conquered death, and He is coming soon to awaken His sleeping saints to everlasting life!
